videos.title: DIY Accounting Submit: view your VAT obligations
videos.description: DIY Accounting Submit is a free tool for sending VAT returns to HMRC under Making Tax Digital. This video shows signing in, taking out a day pass, and asking HMRC which VAT periods are due on a VAT registration number. It's a real recording of the live product, not a mockup or a design draft. Try it yourself at https://submit.diyaccounting.co.uk.

videos.title: DIY Accounting Submit: view a submitted VAT return
videos.description: DIY Accounting Submit is a free tool for sending VAT returns to HMRC under Making Tax Digital. This video shows signing in, taking out a day pass, and opening a VAT return already on file with HMRC to read back all nine boxes. The return on screen was filed earlier, off camera, with Box 6 (total sales excluding VAT) at £5,000. It's a real recording of the live product, not a mockup or a design draft. Try it yourself at https://submit.diyaccounting.co.uk.

videos.title: DIY Accounting Submit: file a quarterly update with HMRC (sandbox)
videos.description: DIY Accounting Submit is a free tool for filing Self Assessment under Making Tax Digital for Income Tax. This video shows signing in, taking out Resident ITSA, asking HMRC which businesses and quarterly obligations sit against a National Insurance number, then opening the form a quarterly update is filed on. This is a sandbox preview, recorded against HMRC's test environment, not a live filing. Try the VAT side of the product now at https://submit.diyaccounting.co.uk.
